entry_points.text: Eventfd and epoll creation validate and delegate to shared creators; control copies config for carrying ops then delegates blocking.
Wait variants normalize timeout and signals then share helper; millisecond, timespec, absent and compat forms.

Context files handle release, poll, ioctls and seek; poll scans promoted items, item sampling delegates with mask, ioctls forward params with set needing zero pad, bounded micros, zero-or-one prefer and privilege for large budget, get returning triple and unknown rejected, plus NAPI suspend and resume when valid and prefer; release wakes, detaches and drops reference.

exports.text: Check descriptor family by operations with bad descriptor or invalid argument failures; on close detach all interests with guard and ref drops.

Control resolves files with bad descriptor on failure and dispatches add, modify, delete; file path enforces poll support, wakeup privilege, self ban, exclusive limits, implied error and hangup, and duplicate versus missing outcomes.
Harvest needs positive bounded count and writable area then transfers without sleep with suspension on success; lookup scans under guard skipping matches and returns file or missing.

hazards.text: Pinning resolves detach versus close; teardown unlinks tolerantly walking and freeing chain with null publish, null head means done and untouched with non-null alive under lock. Insertion validates after linkage and rolls back with cleanup.
Sources created and held awake with mutex, presence and RCU variants; destruction nulls, waits for readers then unregisters.
Private groups wakeup, oneshot, edge, exclusive; exclusive allows in, out, err, hup, wakeup, edge, exclusive. Readiness uses input plus read; quota, memory, nesting map to standard errors.

Nesting limit four; max events is largest signed int divided by record size; inactive marker is all-bits-set pointer; per-item cost covers item plus attachment; tally depth five; back-path limits thousand, five hundred, hundred, fifty, ten.
External locking, RCU, list, wait, memory, time and power helpers owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Read and write move exactly eight bytes with interruptible sleep on empty or full unless nonblock or nowait, write rejecting all-ones; read drains and wakes writers, write adds and wakes readers; info shows hex value, id and semaphore flag.

Creation checks flag equivalence and semaphore bit, rejects unknown bits, inits state, gets anonymous file with nowait and publishes descriptor. Quota checked against max with distinct failures; resolution uses mutex with retry.

Tree orders by file then descriptor with cached leftmost; attach reuses or publishes head; poll records callback and picks exclusive or shared; visited uses null versus sentinel with refcount; last removal publishes null; identity by operations with get; diag walks emitting descriptor, mask, data, position, inode and device stopping on overflow.
Ready by link; available when nonempty, scanning or seq moved with container from wait elements. Negative waits forever, zero polls, positive sets seconds plus nanos deadline with slack.
Fast path or global mutex with generation; reject cycles and over-depth with cleanup. Reverse rejects on depth or per-level over-limit; top exempt; deletes keep checks conservative.

Busy active with timeout check else global and end handling; NAPI needs valid id, clears and resumes on miss, captures only valid changes. Caches read-only after init with generation; per-user limit bounded long with no-op fallback.

locks.text: Eventfd counter and queue guarded by queue lock with interrupts disabled across check, sleep, update and wake via private data; diag samples briefly.

Mutex serializes tree, linkage, scans and drains; file spin guards heads, ready spin guards ready and overflow; RCU or mutex protects linkage and wakeup with deferred free; modify uses barrier; safewake uses depth-keyed lock or plain.

state_machines.text: Idle inactive, scan null. Scan batches ready, chains arrivals LIFO, drains with FIFO requeue via head insertion holding sources, restores inactive, returns leftovers, relaxes source and wakes if ready remains. Wait checks, transfers, sleeps exclusively with autoremove progress; send delivers up to limit, detaches and resamples, retries on fault, disarms one-shot, requeues level with handoff, edge stays detached, preserving first fault when none delivered.
Starts with one creation ref, gains per registration, loses per detach and release, frees via deferred reclaim at zero; closure wakes pollers then detaches hooks and interests with pauses.
Inserts with promotion if ready, modifies or promotes via callback, later removes; idle promotes, scan chains, one-shot with only private bits suppresses.

structs.text: Eventfd binds release, poll, read, write, no-op seek and info when enabled; user record holds mask then token with advancing store.
Context holds mutex, queues, ready list with spin and seq, tree, overflow, wakeup, accounting, file and refs; control records instance, visited and tally; header and wrapper pair table with item.
Interest overlays tree and free links, carries ready, overflow, key, hooks, owner, file link, RCU wakeup and user record; attachment holds successor, owner, wait element and head.
